title: Evidence Binding for Auditable Scientific Agents
problemAndScope: We evaluate claim-level binding in a controlled computational setting.
currentEvidence: Prior evidence supports traceability as an audit mechanism.
candidateHypotheses: Binding reduces unsupported claims relative to an unbound baseline.
falsificationAndResearchPlan: Use paired runs and reject the hypothesis if no reduction is observed.
executionStatusAndResults: The fixture run executed and produced an unsupported-claim rate of 0.12.
limitationsAndUncertainty: The demonstration uses a small fixture and is not a competition result.
